_readme: ONE list that drives checkout (allowed_countries + shipping_options), Offer/OfferShippingDetails/MerchantReturnPolicy JSON-LD, the Merchant Center feed and the visible 'ships to' lines. Only `live` is ever emitted. `pending` is a candidate list: it is NEVER read by checkout, schema, feed or pages (a test fails the build if it leaks). To launch a country: fill printSite, shippingRate, handlingDays, transitDays from IngramSpark's ship-to data (pmpublish 2026-11-09, /home/deploy/aeo-state/fhb-ingram-shipto-20261108.json), set status live, and move the row from `pending` to `live`. Rates are fixed per order (Stripe shipping rates cannot vary by item count). shippingRate.value is a decimal string in `currency`.
